title: TAI exact-main protected controller synchronization
objective: Remove the exact production blocker INSTALLED_CONTROLLER_NOT_EXACT_TARGET by adding an owner-only, pinned-SSH, live-revision-bound command that atomically synchronizes only the root-owned TAI release controller and its recorded SHA-256 before normal preflight, activation and deployment resume, while ensuring canonical exact-main images are published for the merge SHA.
boundaries: The production command is exactly /tai sync-controller current-main on issue 3365 and only the repository owner may invoke it
The target SHA must equal both current main and the live REG.RU deployment manifest before SSH mutation
Production access reuses the protected root SSH principal, pinned host fingerprint and canonical VPS identity already required by the full-stack release authority
Only /usr/local/sbin/pc-tai-release-controller and sudoControllerSha256 in the existing root-owned runner authority manifest may change
The existing runner identity, service, no-Docker boundary, sudoers contract, repository identity and manifest schema must pass before mutation
Controller and manifest backups are restored automatically on any failure before terminal evidence
Canonical API, web, TAI and migration images are published only after merge for the exact new main SHA
No role, tenant, model, database, tool, staff, financial or application data authority is widened
REG.RU only and zero new recurring cost
